name: 94901 · San Rafael, CA
findings: ZIP 94901 (San Rafael) has 346 nonprofit organizations. 157 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94901 (San Rafael) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94901 (San Rafael) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 130 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
